trans-unit.source: The world of fifty years later...
trans-unit.target: The world of fifty years later...

trans-unit.source: That means we're out here somewhere, approaching our 70s.
trans-unit.target: That means we're out here somewhere, approaching our 70s.

trans-unit.source: Don't forget the wrinkled-over granny about to turn 170.
trans-unit.target: Don't forget the wrinkled-over granny about to turn 170.

trans-unit.source: What's the problem? Half-elves are supposed to be long-lived.
trans-unit.target: What's the problem? Half-elves are supposed to be long-lived.

trans-unit.source: Be thankful. After all, I'm no doubt pushing up the daisies here.
trans-unit.target: Be thankful. After all, I'm no doubt pushing up the daisies here.

trans-unit.source: I see tact still isn't your strong point!
trans-unit.target: I see tact still isn't your strong point!
